description: Variation of condition 2 (compliance with approved drawings) of planning permission 24/08470 (Replacement of mansard roof with terrace above (terrace as approved under PP/22/03957); elevational alterations to front and rear (works to the rear consented under CL/24/00398) to install a Juliet balcony to front elevation at first floor level and provision of a basement beneath the property (as approved under PP/23/08191)) to allow changing position and size of entrance door and window; alteration of the garage door design; replacement of consented timber cladding at ground floor level with brick fa‡ade; alteration of design of first floor level doors; increase in length of first-floor sash window; increase in height of mansard roof to maintain correct proportions; and associated modification of rear elevation; and provision of conservation style rooflight with central division replacing previously approved design.
